dataset: Mumbai Designated Emergency Flood Relief Shelters and Evacuation Centres
source: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) Disaster Management Department (Disaster Management Plan 2024–2026)
coverage: Key evacuation shelters across Island City, Western Suburbs, and Eastern Suburbs
limitations: Shelters listed represent high-capacity designated primary relief centers with dedicated municipal facilities (water tanks, backup power generators, first aid supplies). Secondary classroom wings can be requisitioned during catastrophic emergencies.
processing: Verified addresses cross-referenced with municipal ward directories and geocoded into precise coordinates. No coordinates were fabricated.
notes: Directly integrated into emergency pathfinding algorithms for routing affected citizens away from inundated sectors to the nearest reachable shelter with spare capacity.
